issue_categories.resolution: Changed these readings to word_anchor and rewrote the overlays around their verified vocabulary. Under contract v2, all eight remaining integrated_sound_cue readings have both an explicit, phonetically defensible hook and an explicit tone path; visual tone motion alone is not accepted as sound retrieval.

Removed deed/did, she-is, Leo, English men, taaa, HOW, yow, quite, Joe, choo, and similar devices. Retained only close, explicit hooks with strong acoustic and visual value: whoa/wǒ, knee/nǐ, boo/bù, letter E/yī, yo-yo/yǒu, wren/rén, nah/nà, and hen/hěn.

Audited every reading by strategy. Eight integrated cues contain an explicit close sound hook plus tone path; three phonetic-component readings remain source-backed; all 53 word anchors are treated only as supporting vocabulary and tone context, never as if their pictures independently supplied the syllable.
Replaced generic statements that a syllable rises, falls, or stays level with concrete micro-scenes in which the anchor word, semantic scene, and tone motion perform one memorable action.
Reauthored the weak bridges as single spatial or temporal scenes with a distinct station or action for every reading.
Removed the unsupported shore in 说, represented 那 as 哪 minus its question mouth, tied hái to the supplied 还是 choice anchor, and stopped conflating the 里 distance scene with the 里面 usage scene.
Kept yī and bù as the canonical stored readings while explicitly separating their common connected-speech forms from those canonical values.
No unsupported phonetic component was retained. The only phonetic-component strategies are the canonical, source-backed 门／門→们, 马／馬→吗, and 相→想 relationships.
Every revised overlay encodes high-level, rising, dip-and-recovery, falling, or neutral behavior as appropriate.

concrete_fixes.before: A deed hits the white bullseye and rebounds upward: ‘It dí(d), really!’
concrete_fixes.after: An inspector checks the bullseye and lifts a green flag: 的确, really. Dí rises with the confirming flag.

concrete_fixes.before: She plants her straight foot under the sun and declares ‘she IS.’
concrete_fixes.after: The straight foot remains planted beneath the sun while a judge stamps down the 是 verdict, anchored by 但是.

concrete_fixes.before: Leo bends down to inspect the completed work, then springs up because he understands it.
concrete_fixes.after: The inspector bends over the finished work and straightens as he 了解 it, making the semantic completion scene and third-tone motion do the memory work.

concrete_fixes.before: The gate is full of English ‘men.’
concrete_fixes.after: 门／門 mén supplies the authenticated sound family; 们 relaxes to neutral men in 我们.

concrete_fixes.before: The lone horizontal line showed high-level tone and sandhi but supplied no way to retrieve the syllable yī.
concrete_fixes.after: A single letter E now provides the close /iː/ sound hook for yī on the high, level line; the overlay still distinguishes yí before tone 4 and yì before tones 1–3.

concrete_fixes.before: ‘How good?’ and a shouted ‘HOW!’ distinguish the readings.
concrete_fixes.after: One woman-and-child scene contains a bow-and-rise greeting for 你好 hǎo and a hobby poster pinned downward for 爱好 hào.

concrete_fixes.before: The bridge says people meet for huì while an accountant says ‘quite right’ for kuài.
concrete_fixes.after: A single meeting room now has a raffle station for 机会 huì and a ledger station for 会计 kuài, with no English ‘quite’ approximation.
The capital summons its remarkable leader at precisely the right moment, and a seal drops on 就是 jiù.

concrete_fixes.before: Each speaker stands on the shore, although no shore exists in the semantic decomposition.
concrete_fixes.after: The verified 讠 speech + 兑 exchange scene carries a high, level speech bubble for 说话 shuō.
The buried-secret scene continues into a calendar page falling into 过去, tying qù to the verified word without the inaccurate English vowel.

concrete_fixes.before: The traveler is merely ‘still moving,’ while the supplied anchor is 还是, glossed ‘or.’
concrete_fixes.after: The traveler pauses at a fork and raises a hand toward the alternative path—还是, this or that—on rising hái.

concrete_fixes.before: The bridge lists obtain, must, and a neutral structural particle.
concrete_fixes.after: One traveler lifts the obtained prize for dé, slumps and recovers for obligatory děi, then attaches a light structural de tag to the finished action.

concrete_fixes.before: The bridge states that dōu means all and dū means capital.
concrete_fixes.after: One city scene places all residents under a level dōu banner and the 首都 tower under its own level dū line.

concrete_fixes.before: An unrelated English ‘she’ drops a marker onto the matter.
concrete_fixes.after: The semantic hand grips the matter marker and stamps the 事情 case file on falling shì.

concrete_fixes.before: The bridge only states that full zǐ names children and neutral zi is a suffix.
concrete_fixes.after: At one playground the child’s raised arms trace zǐ in 子女, then the same child’s lighter footsteps tag behind 孩 in 孩子.
